newsArray.title: Nagaland quartet picked for NE Zone Duleep Trophy squad
newsArray.description: Dimapur, July 31 (MExN): Four cricketers from Nagaland, including three main squad members and one standby, have been selected for the North East Zone team for the 2026–27 Duleep Trophy, while the state’s senior men’s team physiotherapist has also been appointed to the zonal side.In a press release, the Nagaland Cricket Association (NCA) informed that Jonathan Rongsen, Imliwati Lemtur and Vino G. Zhimomi have been named in the North East Zone squad for the prestigious domestic tournament. Hem Bahadur Chetri has been selected as a standby player.The Duleep Trophy 2026–27 is scheduled to be held from August 23 to September 10 at the BCCI Centre of Excellence in Bengaluru.The NCA further announced that Mowalong Kichu, physiotherapist of the Nagaland Senior Men’s Team, has been appointed as the Team Physiotherapist for the North East Zone squad.Ahead of the tournament, the association will host the North East Zone pre-tournament preparatory camp in Nagaland from August 8 to 19.Describing the selections as “a proud moment for cricket in Nagaland,” the association said they reflect the commitment, consistent performances and contribution of the players and support staff towards the growth of the sport in the state.The NCA congratulated Jonathan Rongsen, Imliwati Lemtur, Vino G. Zhimomi, Hem Bahadur Chetri and Mowalong Kichu on their selection and appointment, and wished the North East Zone squad success in the upcoming Duleep Trophy campaign.
